description: Propose removing ALL speaker enrollments with {}. To recover an incompatible/corrupt UID store, close speech and supply recovery with the two exact hashes (or absent) from speaker.list.recovery. After operator confirmation, recovery archives BOTH original files in private content-addressed storage, clears pending recordings, and creates an empty profile for the current model. This is not embedding conversion. Changed bytes require a fresh confirmation. No caller storage path or confirmation stamp.

session_id.description: Optional session consistency check from speaker.list. Omit when managing enrollment without an open speech session.

recovery.description: Optional operator-confirmed recovery of incompatible or corrupt UID storage. Copy both exact digests from speaker.list.recovery. Requires a closed speech session; original files are archived before an empty current-model profile is created. Omit for normal reset.

enrollment_sha256.description: Copy speaker.list.recovery.enrollment_sha256 exactly: the observed enrollment file SHA-256, or absent only when that observation reports no file.

captures_sha256.description: Copy speaker.list.recovery.captures_sha256 exactly: the observed captures file SHA-256, or absent only when that observation reports no file.
